arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Brown argued Congress granted the Federal Circuit jurisdiction. She cited Section 1295(a)(9) and Section 7703(b)(1).
Mr. Davis argued the Court has clarified the law. He stated procedural rules are not jurisdictional without clear congressional intent.
Justice Sotomayor asked if courts of appeals are ill suited for factual findings. She questioned the government's argument on this point.
Justice Jackson asked if the Federal Circuit precedent holds the deadline is not subject to equitable forfeiture. She referenced specific case law.
